public_rationale: On May 23, 2024, The Verge quoted Google's recommendation to mix about 1/8 cup of Elmer’s glue into pizza sauce and identified a decade-old Reddit comment as its apparent source [e5]. On May 24, Ars Technica reported that the recommendation to use 1/8 cup of non-toxic glue to stop cheese sliding off pizza could be traced to an 11-year-old Reddit post [e6].
limitations: The original Reddit thread was inaccessible; source attribution relies on contemporary reporting.
No internal Google trace establishes how the source reached the system, including whether through training or search.
The reports contain different answer wordings and do not authenticate every word of Marcus's example.
Ars does not explicitly establish that it reproduced this particular answer or observed it on May 23.
